name: Curvature
intro: Twisting is jammed here: the only way through the fourth dimension is to let space do it. Each lap around the glowing pillar shifts your colour by one layer: clockwise goes up (red → gold), counter-clockwise goes down (red → violet). That is holonomy: in curved space, going round a loop turns you.
hint: Loop the glowing pillar: clockwise = next colour, counter-clockwise = previous.
